title: The signed contract, on the company page
text: A company's page now has a Signed contract line in Company Info, right under How they became our client. Press Open and the signed PDF shows in a floating window on top of the page. You can move it, resize it, and keep working on the page behind it. A company with no contract on record says so, and an annual renewal agreement is shown too, named as a renewal. Only the contracts that belong to this company are listed. Amounts are still corrected from the person's page.
points: Open a company and look in Company Info, under How they became our client.
Each signed contract has a line with its name and the day it was signed, and an Open button.
Open shows the PDF in a floating window. If it cannot show it, it offers to open it in a new tab.
A company with no signed contract on record says: No signed contract in the system.
An annual renewal agreement is listed as Annual renewal agreement with its year, after the contract the client signed when they became a client.
